sourceText: User asked to write a detailed execution plan for Parent Roadmap Completion Gate / User Intent Totality Gate, including how many milestones are required, and clarified that the first milestone must be writing test cases / Red-Repro before executing the full story.
normalizedOutcome: A plan document exists that starts with Red/Repro test-first milestone and then lists the full implementation milestones for preventing parent-roadmap completion overclaims.
acceptanceClaim: The plan names the B-43de/B-5082 failure mode, makes Red/Repro tests milestone M1, defines parent-child completion rules, and lists all implementation milestones needed before a full roadmap completion claim is allowed.
